dct_title_s: Fayette County, Iowa, 1937, aerial photomosaic index
dct_description_sm: Title supplied by cataloger based on information from sheet labels. Images are photoreductions of mosaics created from original aerial photographs. Designating symbol SS; form of individual image numbering: SS-9-[number], SS-10-[number], SS-11-[number], SS-12-[number], SS-13-[number], SS-14-[number], SS-23-[number], SS-28-[number], or SS-31-[number]. "Date of completion 10-29-37". Flown by Gatschet Aerial Surveys, Des Moines, Iowa. "Approximate scale, 1:20,000" [refers to individual images from which mosaic was made]. Library's copy 2 consists of photographic negatives (4 x 5 in.) corresponding to each of the images in its copy 1.
